info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservation Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of parking reservations. This endpoint is designed for applications that need to display or manage parking reservation statuses, making it ideal for parking management systems and related third-party services. By querying this API, consumers can obtain real-time information about their reservations, ensuring they can efficiently manage their parking needs. Typical use cases include providing users with updates on reservation status and supporting administrative oversight of parking resources.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of reservations. It provides vital information which helps users to understand whether their reservations are confirmed, pending, or canceled.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of reservations. It includes the necessary parameters required to determine the reservation's current state.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of reservations.

ListParkingReservationsStatusRequest.description: The request body representing the status of reservations in string format.

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reservation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit of the operation.

ListParkingReservationsStatusResponse_20.description: Schema representing the response structure for successful reservation status retrieval.

createdBy.description: The user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information about the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A lower value indicates a faster response time.
